summary: Polish the live transcript kit: nested work-log folds share one capped scroller with Thinking, tool rows pin a bounded status word and a tabular duration, Markdown uses even sibling rhythm with nested list rails, whole-run Copy confirms only after a successful clipboard write, and seat prose headers can be hidden. Disclosure glyphs rotate inside a fixed slot. App tests share one StyleX runtime mock.

compatibility.detail: The fgFaint color token is removed from both kit theme contracts; its former callers use fgMuted. The legacy transcript prose export is renamed SeatProse. Transcript accepts optional showSeatHeader (default true), and Markdown accepts an optional tone of foreground for input bodies. Light Embrace good and added defaults are concrete colors instead of aliases.
